alpr.overview: A complete Automatic License Plate Recognition pipeline. The backend is a FastAPI service exposing inference and management endpoints; the frontend is a React dashboard with real-time updates, recognition history and analytics.
alpr.challenges: Designing a low-latency inference pipeline, handling diverse plate formats, and streaming results to the dashboard without dropping frames.
alpr.result: A reliable system used end-to-end, with clean separation between detection, OCR and presentation layers.
